alt: Reading a bracket string one character at a time, pushing every opener onto a stack and popping it when a matching closer arrives, marking the string valid when the stack ends empty and invalid on a mismatch, an empty stack facing a closer, or unclosed openers at the end.

steps.caption: '{' is an opener. Push it. The stack is now ['{'].
'[' is an opener. Push it. The stack is now ['{', '['].
'(' is an opener. Push it. The stack is now ['{', '[', '('].
')' matches the top of the stack, '('. Pop it. The stack is now ['{', '['].
'(' is an opener. Push it. The stack is now ['{', '[', '('].
')' matches the top of the stack, '('. Pop it. The stack is now ['{', '['].
']' matches the top of the stack, '['. Pop it. The stack is now ['{'].
'}' matches the top of the stack, '{'. Pop it. The stack is now [].
Every character is read and the stack is empty. The string is valid.
'(' is an opener. Push it. The stack is now ['('].
'[' is an opener. Push it. The stack is now ['(', '['].
')' does not match the top of the stack, '['. Invalid.
'(' is an opener. Push it. The stack is now ['('].
'(' is an opener. Push it. The stack is now ['(', '('].
')' matches the top of the stack, '('. Pop it. The stack is now ['('].
Every character is read, but ['('] is still on the stack: an unclosed opener. Invalid.
